capabilities: Search the vault by meaning with plain-language queries
Review ranked semantic results with scores and expandable previews
Open results or drag them into notes as links
Package found notes into AI-ready context bundles via Smart Context
disambiguation: Not a dictionary or external-reference lookup; it searches only your own vault, and it is not a replacement for exact-word Obsidian search.
extras: Freemium: Core question-first search runs locally with no API key; Pro adds Environment Pro acceleration and Generate HyDE. Source-available under the Smart Plugins License. Part of the Smart Plugins ecosystem; requires waiting for Smart Environment indexing before results are ready.
intentEvidence: Use Lookup when meaning is the anchor. Use Obsidian search when exact words, tags, headings, filenames, syntax, or regex are the anchor.
problem: Obsidian search matches exact words, operators, and syntax, so notes that use different vocabulary than your query are hard to recover.

relations.evidence: Smart Lookup is built on obsidian-smart-env.
use Smart Context to create a reviewable context bundle
Smart Connections surfaces related notes from the current note.

summary: Question-first semantic search for a vault: ask in plain language, review ranked meaning-based matches, then open, link, or package them as AI context.
